delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

fallback_layer.description: which layer of the fallback chain took over; none in this build, which holds the manifest on the last segment

spliced_at_media_sequence.description: the media sequence where a fallback layer was spliced in; null when nothing was spliced at loss, which is every build with fallback_layer none

reason.description: publisher_timeout is an EOF whose last packet is older than the transport's peer-idle window; publisher_closed is any other EOF; source_error is a read error; node_draining is the node's own drain (a restart or a stop) holding a session that was live, which the next start continues; encoder_death is not emitted by this build
